title: The Verification Foundry — ChaCha20 Quarter-Round Bijectivity Certificate
subject: A real crypto round function proved injective by two independent SMT engines
provers: cvc5 1.3.4 (SMT — independent engine; same SMT-LIB family, so a corroboration not an independence)

obligations.name: chacha20_qr_injective
obligations.statement: ChaCha20 quarter-round (RFC 8439) is INJECTIVE: QR(s1) = QR(s2) => s1 = s2 over the 128-bit state — hence a bijection. A full add/rotate/xor round function.
obligations.smt2:
; obligation: the ChaCha20 quarter-round (RFC 8439) is INJECTIVE (a bijection).
; Two input states; assert their QR outputs are equal componentwise AND the inputs
; differ. unsat = injective (no two distinct states collide). A full add/rotate/xor
; round function over a 128-bit state — a genuinely harder QF_BV instance.
(set-logic QF_BV)
(declare-const ax (_ BitVec 32))
(declare-const bx (_ BitVec 32))
(declare-const cx (_ BitVec 32))
(declare-const dx (_ BitVec 32))
(define-fun A1x () (_ BitVec 32) (bvadd ax bx))
(define-fun D1x () (_ BitVec 32) ((_ rotate_left 16) (bvxor dx A1x)))
(define-fun C1x () (_ BitVec 32) (bvadd cx D1x))
(define-fun B1x () (_ BitVec 32) ((_ rotate_left 12) (bvxor bx C1x)))
(define-fun A2x () (_ BitVec 32) (bvadd A1x B1x))
(define-fun D2x () (_ BitVec 32) ((_ rotate_left 8) (bvxor D1x A2x)))
(define-fun C2x () (_ BitVec 32) (bvadd C1x D2x))
(define-fun B2x () (_ BitVec 32) ((_ rotate_left 7) (bvxor B1x C2x)))
(declare-const ay (_ BitVec 32))
(declare-const by (_ BitVec 32))
(declare-const cy (_ BitVec 32))
(declare-const dy (_ BitVec 32))
(define-fun A1y () (_ BitVec 32) (bvadd ay by))
(define-fun D1y () (_ BitVec 32) ((_ rotate_left 16) (bvxor dy A1y)))
(define-fun C1y () (_ BitVec 32) (bvadd cy D1y))
(define-fun B1y () (_ BitVec 32) ((_ rotate_left 12) (bvxor by C1y)))
(define-fun A2y () (_ BitVec 32) (bvadd A1y B1y))
(define-fun D2y () (_ BitVec 32) ((_ rotate_left 8) (bvxor D1y A2y)))
(define-fun C2y () (_ BitVec 32) (bvadd C1y D2y))
(define-fun B2y () (_ BitVec 32) ((_ rotate_left 7) (bvxor B1y C2y)))
(assert (and (and (= A2x A2y) (= B2x B2y) (= C2x C2y) (= D2x D2y)) (or (not (= ax ay)) (not (= bx by)) (not (= cx cy)) (not (= dx dy)))))
(check-sat)

z3.method: bit-blast to SAT; unsat of the negation

cvc5.method: independent SMT engine; unsat of the negation

lean.method: kernel-checked invertibility (QRinv o QR = id) is future work; SMT-only obligation (stated honestly)

obligations.coverage: 2-prover SMT (Z3, cvc5) — kernel-algebra leg not attempted

note: Portable evidence: recompute sha256 over {provers, obligations} and re-run any SMT solver on the embedded smt2 (unsat = injective). No access to our pipeline required. HONEST SCOPE: TWO-prover SMT obligation; a kernel-checked Lean invertibility proof is future work and is marked not-attempted, not claimed. Z3 and cvc5 are both SMT/SAT engines — agreement here guards against an engine-specific bug but is corroboration, not strong independence.
